grammar.summary: 本课学习表功能的 serve as 与 not...but 并列结构。

points.title: not...but 转折并列
points.explanation: The bat is not a bird but a mammal. not A but B = 不是A而是B，并列结构的取舍表达。

examples.en: It is not a bird but a flying mammal.
examples.cn: 它不是鸟，而是会飞的哺乳动物。

points.title: serve as 表"充当"
points.explanation: Its ears serve as a radar system. serve as/function as = 起……作用，科技说明文高频。

examples.en: They serve as a kind of radar.
